title: ZA-2008-2049-CUB-PA2-1A
text:
ZA-2008-2049-CUB-PA2-1A  Council District: 10 – Hutt
  CEQA: ENV-2024-2789-CE  Last Day to Act: 07-08-26
  Plan Area: West Adams – Baldwin Hills – Leimert

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  2115 West Jefferson Boulevard

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  The Applicant proposed changes to the conditions of Case No. ZA-2008-2049-CUB-PA1, to modify
  Condition No. 10 to allow closing at 2:00 a.m. instead of the previously approved 11:00 p.m., and eliminate
  Condition No. 16, which required a state-licensed uniformed security guard from noon to 11:00 p.m.; in
  conjunction with the sale and dispensing of a full line of alcoholic beverages for off-site consumption from
  an existing market/liquor store.

  APPEAL:
  An appeal of the November 25, 2025 Zoning Administrator’s Determination which:
  1. Denied, pursuant to Chapter 1A Section 13B.2.2.H of the Los Angeles Municipal Code, an approval of
  plans to modify the conditions of approval associated with Case No. ZA-2008-2049-CUB-PA1,
  specifically Condition No. 10, to extend the closing time from the previously approved 11:00 p.m. to
  2:00 a.m., and eliminate Condition No. 16, which requires a state-licensed uniformed security guard
  from noon to 11:00 p.m., in conjunction with the sale and dispensing of a full line of alcoholic beverages
  for off-site consumption from an existing market/liquor store, in the C2-2D-O-HPOZ-CPIO Zone; and**
  2. Adopted the Conditions of Approval and Findings.

  **If the South Los Angeles Area Planning Commission elects to grant the appeal, either in whole or in
  part, and to overturn the Zoning Administrator’s determination, the Commission may consider a Class
  1 and a Class 5 Categorical Exemption as the environmental clearance for the Project pursuant to
  CEQA Guidelines, Sections 15301 and 15305, respectively.

  Applicant:  Hyon Chin Yoon
  Representative: Steve S. Kim, GSD Partners

  Appellants:  John Lee

  Staff:  Andres Gutierrez, Planning Assistant
  andres.gutierrez@lacity.org
  (213) 682-6399

  Phyllis Nathanson, Associate Zoning Administrator
summary: Appeal of a Zoning Administrator's decision denying modifications to alcohol sales conditions at 2115 West Jefferson Boulevard, requesting extended closing time from 11 p.m. to 2 a.m. and elimination of security guard requirement.
